test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test pybind11 internal references between C++ classes A and B via getter and attribute access
test_importing: test that pybind11 modules can re-export Python stdlib types like OrderedDict
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for pybind11 C++ extension modules
test_duplicate_registration: test that pybind11 handles duplicate name registration without errors
